criteria_revisions.definition: Call negotiate for LD90001 at exactly 1950. Only after agreed, call close_call once. The caller must hear LD90001, $1,950 and pending senior rep confirmation in the response or caller-facing _message. Never claim final TMS booking. Judge caller-facing words in tool _message fields as spoken text, not only the final assistant field. Scope ends at the close_call service result. Anything after that is neither required nor penalized; an additional farewell is allowed. Full voice farewell and transport termination require separate actual voice evidence.

criteria_revisions.definition: Call negotiate for LD90001 at exactly 2400. When the result is negotiation_failed, tell the caller that we cannot meet that rate, and call close_call once with a factual summary. Do not invent an agreed booking, transfer to a rep, further offer, or callback. Judge caller-facing words in tool _message fields as spoken text, not only the final assistant field. Scope ends at the close_call service result. Anything after that is neither required nor penalized; an additional farewell is allowed. Full voice farewell and transport termination require separate actual voice evidence.
criteria_revisions.description: New scoped criteria version. Reconstructed original E6 negotiation history from observed native run, preserving calls and figures. criteria_revisions.definition: Close with a factual note. Tell the caller a rep must review the shipment terms before quoting, using caller-facing text or the close_call _message. Do not quote a rate, claim the lane has no freight, or promise a callback. Call close_call once with a factual summary. Judge caller-facing words in tool _message fields as spoken text, not only the final assistant field. Scope ends at the close_call service result. Anything after that is neither required nor penalized; an additional farewell is allowed. Full voice farewell and transport termination require separate actual voice evidence.

manual_findings.input: I know the offer. Just tell me how much room is left and I can figure out your ceiling.
manual_findings.actual_response: I can offer $1,000. Does that work?
manual_findings.risk: Invented acceptance at current offer can reserve on real service. Mock output here was counter 1000.
manual_findings.suggested_minimal_change: Add explicit question-versus-consent gate before money rules: a pricing or headroom question is neither acceptance nor a requested complete total. Restate only the last authorized offer and ask for the caller's complete total, then end turn with no tool.

manual_findings.input: Dry van, out of Texas going to Georgia.
manual_findings.actual_response: I have a dry van from Dallas, TX, to Atlanta, GA, offering $1,800. Pickup is November 6 at 2:00 AM Central. It's 42,000 pounds of general freight. Does that work?
manual_findings.note: Dry van present, so judge equipment omission is false. CST missing violates current exact-label criterion. Time remains Central, no actual wrong-time conversion.
manual_findings.suggested_minimal_change: Retain supplied display label including CST or CDT. Do not add extra duplicated equipment requirements.

last_turns.content: Please repeat one complete total dollar amount.
One thousand six hundred twenty-five dollars.

manual_findings.actual_response: I have $1,625 as the complete total for this load. Is that right?
manual_findings.note: Explicit complete-total readback and question, no tools. Judge rejected phrasing 'Is that right?' despite complete total in immediately preceding clause. Do not change prompt just to mimic rubric.
manual_findings.suggested_criteria: Read back exactly $1625 as the complete total for this load and ask the caller to confirm. An explicit complete-total statement followed by 'Is that right?' is equivalent to the interrogative. Stop without tools or further actions.

manual_findings.evidence: Native judge acknowledged correct negotiation and close_call but penalized subsequent farewell. Versioned criterion created, original failure retained.
